notes: Added audit/compliance and cross-service integration coverage to close HIPAA enforcement gaps.

change_log.note: Add auditability required for HIPAA compliance
Ensure all shared services consistently enforce consent

SHARED-F-2-S6.title: Consent Audit Logging and Traceability
SHARED-F-2-S6.description: Implement audit logging for all consent events including capture, upgrade, and enforcement decisions. Logs must include timestamp, consent tier, action taken, and service context to support compliance review and incident investigation.

SHARED-F-2-S7.title: Cross-Service Consent Enforcement Integration
SHARED-F-2-S7.description: Integrate consent enforcement across all shared domain services (lead_capture, unknown_question_service, safety_service) ensuring every data persistence or external call validates consent tier before execution.
